item.title: International Olympic Academy Hold Meeting With IOA, Lauds Reactivation Of The National Olympic Academy Of India
item.description: The International Olympic Academy: A delegation from the International Olympic Academy (IOA), led by Dr Makis Asimakopoulos, Director, and Ms Alexandra Karaiskou, Head of NOAS/NOCs Relations, held an official meeting with the President of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) P. T. Usha, at the headquarters of the Indian Olympic Association here on Monday.

item.title: T20 WC: Sri Lanka President Thanks Pakistan PM For Agreeing To Play India In Colombo
item.description: Sri Lanka President Anura Kumara: Sri Lanka President Anura Kumara Dissanayake thanked Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif for confirming that the T20 World Cup 2026 match between India and Pakistan will go ahead.

item.title: DP World Players Championship To Tee-off On Tuesdat At Qutab Golf Course
item.description: DP World PGTI Qualifying School: DP World and the Professional Golf Tour of India (PGTI) have jointly launched the DP World Players Championship.

item.title: T20 WC: Klaassen, Van Der Gugten Come In As Netherlands Elect To Bowl First Against Namibia
item.description: T20 World Cup: Netherlands have brought in pacers Fred Klaassen and Timm van der Gugten as skipper Scott Edwards won the toss and elected to bowl first against Namibia in a Group A clash of the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup at the Arun Jaitley Stadium on Tuesday.

item.title: Vani, Ridhima And Tvesa Look To Regain Form In Leg 3 Of Eomen’s PGT
item.description: Bombay Presidency Golf Club: Vani Kapoor, Ridhima Dilawari, Amandeep Drall and Sneha Singh will be among the top names who will tee up at the third leg of the Women’s Pro Golf Tour at the Oxford Golf Resort in Pune.

item.title: 'Just Theatrics': Political Leaders Question Pakistan’s U-turn On India T20 World Cup Match
item.description: India T20 World Cup: The decision by Pakistan to withdraw its boycott and confirm participation in the high-profile T20 World Cup clash against India has triggered sharp political reactions in India, with leaders across party lines weighing in on the controversy and its wider implications for sports and diplomacy.

item.title: Etcheverry, Martinez Advance At Argentina Open
item.description: Buenos Aires Lawn Tennis Club: Argentine seventh seed Tomas Etcheverry progressed to the Argentina Open round of 16 with a 6-3, 6-4 win over Italian qualifier Andrea Pellegrino.

item.title: 'No WAGs' Policy Intact For Indian Players In T20 WC: Report
item.description: T20 World Cup: The BCCI has stuck to its policy of players' families not being allowed to stay with them during the duration of the T20 World Cup campaign, as per reports.

item.title: 'Fit and Motivated' India Eye Strong Start To FIH Men’s Pro League Campaign In Rourkela
item.description: The Hero Hockey India League: The Indian men’s hockey team will open its FIH Men’s Pro League 2025–26 campaign at home during the Rourkela leg, scheduled from February 10 to 15 at the Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium, where the hosts will take on Belgium and Argentina in what promises to be a high-intensity start to the season.

item.title: Ashoke Pandit Opposes India Playing With Pakistan In The T20 World Cup: I Am Completely Against This
item.description: IFTDA President Ashoke Pandit: IFTDA President Ashoke Pandit has expressed his displeasure at India playing the T-20 World Cup against Pakistan.
